technique: MRI brain, dedicated epilepsy protocol with thin cut coronal FLAIR and T1 sequences through the hippocampi.
findings: The right hippocampus is small with increased T2 and FLAIR signal and loss of the internal architecture. The right temporal horn is mildly asymmetric. There is no mass. The adjacent temporal white matter is thinned and a 4 mm focal cortical irregularity is seen on the adjacent gyrus, of uncertain significance. The findings are unchanged from the MRI of 4 months ago, which described the same hippocampal signal abnormality.
impression: Right mesial temporal sclerosis, concordant with the reported semiology. A possible adjacent focal cortical lesion cannot be excluded on this study.
recommendations: Epilepsy surgical assessment with volumetric analysis, and consider PET or 3T dedicated sequences with video EEG correlation.
follow_up: Review in 12 months, or earlier if the seizure frequency changes.
